description: This file defines the ClientTransactionRepositoryWrapper class, which serves as a service layer abstraction around the ClientTransactionRepository. It provides methods to find, save, and delete ClientTransaction entities, and includes logic to handle not-found scenarios and enrich transactions with currency details.

classes.name: ClientTransactionRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A Spring service class that wraps repository operations for ClientTransaction entities, adding additional logic such as not-found detection and currency enrichment.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves a ClientTransaction by ID, throws exception if not found or if client ID does not match, and enriches the transaction with currency details.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists a ClientTransaction to the database.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Persists a ClientTransaction and immediately flushes the persistence context.
